transform_haiku_function: transform a python function using Haiku modules into pure init and apply functions
transform_with_state_haiku_function: transform a python function with Haiku modules into pure init and apply functions with state
without_state_transformed_with_state: wrap a transformed with state function to ignore state input and output
with_empty_state_transformed: wrap a transformed function to pass empty state in and out
running_init_check: check if currently running the init function of a Haiku transform
